info.title: Investflex Algo Trading Platform API
info.description: Authenticated trading API for algorithm execution and monitoring. Includes authentication, algos, algos-copy, webhooks, orders, positions, executions, and strategy-code lookup. Administrative provisioning, risk administration, and market-data routes are excluded. Use the public login or SSO endpoints to obtain an auth token, then send it on protected requests in the Authorization header as Bearer <auth_token>. Login, OTP authentication, and SSO bootstrap endpoints do not require a bearer token.

get.summary: Get position from a account or User. Only positions of orders sent via Flexscan API will be shown here. Order sent through other platforms will not appear here
get.description: This endpoint returns positions according to role scope. `STD` users see their own data; `SPR` and `SIV` have broad access; `UCO` callers must provide `productCode`; other administrative roles are restricted by sponsor/account scope.

parameters.description: The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of items to return

parameters.name: detailed
parameters.description: pass 1 to detailed records

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Filter field. Currently only `account` is supported (default). Used together with `value`.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Filter value for `key`. For administrative roles, restricts the result to the given account (must belong to the sponsor); ignored for `STD` users.

parameters.description: Pass 1/true to merge custody positions into the response. Custody is summed with the position only when the sponsor has `sumCustodyPosEnabled`; otherwise custody records are returned side by side. Only honoured in REAL, SIMULATOR and DEV environments.

parameters.description: Pass 1/true to return the consolidated view (position + custody always summed, regardless of the sponsor setting). Takes precedence over `custody`. When set, `total_records`/`total_pages` are omitted from the response.

parameters.name: financial_calc
parameters.description: Pass 1 to include realized/unrealized P&L, mark-to-market, net financial aggregates, day result and `positionSummary` in the response.

parameters.name: productCode
parameters.description: Required when the authenticated role is the copy operator (UCO). Filters positions to accounts subscribed to this product.

200.description: Paginated position records. `limit` defaults to 25 (max 1000). When the caller has no accounts the `pos_*` aggregates are returned as 0.

post.summary: Sends a single order to execute
post.description:
Creates a single order. Internally the order is executed as a `sorder` strategy (the returned `id` is
its ClOrdID and can be used with `/orders/{id}` and `/algos/{id}`). Only the `STD` role may create orders; other
roles receive 403. Rejected outside trading hours (400).

**Bracket orders.** The optional root fields `takeProfit`, `stopLoss` and `trailingStopPips` are mapped to the
`sorder` CustomParameters `TakeProfit`, `StopLoss` and `TrailingStopPips` and create protective child orders
managed by the order-proxy strategy:

* `takeProfit` → LIMIT child on the opposite side at this price.
* `stopLoss` → STOP LIMIT child on the opposite side with stop price = `stopLoss`; the limit price is set
  automatically with an offset of a few ticks (engine config `BracketStopLimitOffsetPips`, default 10) in the
  direction that favours the fill.
* `trailingStopPips` → trailing STOP LIMIT child; the stop price follows the market at a distance of
  `trailingStopPips × tick size` from the best price reached after the entry fills. Cannot be combined with
  `stopLoss`.

The children are created `SCHEDULED` with their own ClOrdID (`chi1…`/`chi2…`/`chi3…`) pointing back to the
entry through `ParentClOrdID`, are sent to the market only when the entry executes (quantity follows partial
fills), and take profit / stop loss behave as an OCO pair (when one fills the other is reduced or cancelled).
For a BUY entry `takeProfit` must be above and `stopLoss` below `price`/`stopPrice`; the opposite for SELL,
otherwise 400. Bracket levels can later be changed or removed with `PUT /orders/{id}` (`stopLoss`/`takeProfit`
only before the entry executes; `trailingStopPips` also while working). Children are listed in `GET /orders`
as separate records. Advanced bracket controls of the `sorder` strategy (`SyntheticBracket`, `EntranceTimeout`,
`ClosePosition`, `CancelEntranceOnBracketExecution`, `MaxFloor`, `InitSuspended`) are not exposed by this
endpoint; use `POST /algos` with `StrategyCode=sorder` when they are needed.

post.summary: Send a new algo to execution engine
post.description:
Requires execution_service or copy_operation_service access; the authenticated user must satisfy the execution-engine authorization rules.
Select a strategy to execute in the `Examples` dropdown. </br></br>

**Request body structure.** Every strategy request is a flat object made of three groups:

* **General parameters** (root level) — `Name`, `InitTime`, `EndTime`, `StrategyCode`, `ExpireDate`, plus the
  optional `BasketId`, `Text`, `TimeInForce` and `Signature`. These are the same for every strategy and are
  documented in `StrategyCreateBase`.
* **`CustomParameters`** — strategy-specific settings (prices, triggers, stops, etc.). The accepted fields and
  their types are described per strategy in the `ABMessage-<StrategyCode>` schemas.
* **`StrategyLegs`** — the instruments to trade. Every leg accepts the common fields in `StrategyLegBase`
  (`ILegAllocAccount`, `LegSymbol`, `LegSide`, `LegSecurityExchange`, ...) plus strategy-specific leg fields.
  The number of legs allowed depends on the strategy.

Fields marked as *not editable* in the per-strategy schemas can only be set on creation and are ignored by
`PUT /algos/{ClOrdID}`.

**Bracket orders (sorder only).** A single order may carry up to two protective child orders, managed by the
order-proxy strategy (`UseOrderProxy=Y`, the default):

* `TakeProfit` — creates a **take-profit child**: a LIMIT order on the opposite side at this price.
* `StopLoss` — creates a **stop-loss child**: a STOP LIMIT order on the opposite side with `StopPrice=StopLoss`
  and a limit price automatically offset by `BracketStopLimitOffsetPips` ticks (engine config, default 10) in
  the direction that favours the fill.
* `TrailingStopPips` — creates a **trailing-stop child** instead of a fixed stop loss: a STOP LIMIT whose stop
  price follows the market at a distance of `TrailingStopPips × tick size` from the best price reached after the
  entry fills (initial stop = entry price ± distance). `StopLoss` and `TrailingStopPips` are mutually exclusive.

Behaviour:

* Children are created in `SCHEDULED` state (`InitTime=TRIG`) with their own ClOrdID (`chi1…` take profit,
  `chi2…` stop loss, `chi3…` trailing stop) and reference the entry via `ParentClOrdID` in the snapshot; they
  inherit `ExpireDate`, `BasketId` and `TimeInForce` from the entry.
* The children are sent to the market only when the entry order executes; on partial fills their quantity is
  increased to match the executed quantity.
* Take profit and stop loss work as an OCO pair: when one child executes, the other has its quantity reduced by
  the executed amount, or is cancelled when nothing remains.
* On creation the engine validates the price relation: for a BUY entry `TakeProfit` must be above and
  `StopLoss` below the entry price (`PriceLimit`/`StopPrice`); the opposite applies to SELL. Violations return
  400.
* `StopLoss`/`TakeProfit` are stripped from the children's CustomParameters; look at the children's
  `PriceLimit`/`StopPrice` for the effective prices.
* `SyntheticBracket` selects whether the children rest at the exchange (`OFF`) or are held by the engine and
  fired from the trade feed (`AGGRESSOR`, `NEAR`, `GAIN_OFF_LOSS_AGG`); see the field description in
  `ABMessage-sorder`.
* Additional entry controls: `EntranceTimeout` (cancel the unfilled entry after N seconds),
  `CancelEntranceOnBracketExecution` (cancel the unfilled entry when a bracket child executes) and
  `ClosePosition=1` (flatten the executed quantity at market on `EndTime`).
* Editing: `StopLoss`, `TakeProfit` and `TrailingStopPips` may be changed through `PUT /algos/{ClOrdID}`
  (sending the field replaces the level; omitting a level that exists removes it and cancels that child).
  Fixed `StopLoss`/`TakeProfit` can only be changed before the entry executes; `TrailingStopPips` can also be
  changed while the trailing child is working. Adding a bracket to an order that already has a trailing stop is
  rejected, and `StopLoss` + `TrailingStopPips` in the same request is rejected.

Use `AlgosList` to submit up to 500 strategies in a single request (see the `multiple-orders` example).
</br></br>

 * sorder (Single Order)
 * fxorder (Flex Order)
 * grddin (Gradiente Dinamico)
 * grdlin (Gradiente Linear)
 * spread / spread3p / spread4p / spread5p / spread6p (Spreads 2-6 pontas)
 * lgshort (Long & Short)
 * financ (Financiamento)
 * twap (Time Weighting Average Price)
 * pov (Participation of Volume)
 * iceberg (Iceberg Order)
 * boffer (Best Offer)
 * mit (Market If Touch Order)
 * skew (Skew)
 * cvvol (Compra e Venda de Vol)
 * sniper (Sniper Order)
 * oco (One Cancels the Other)
 * arbintf (Arbitragem Inteiro Fracionario)

put.summary: Send an algo edition for a running strategy to execution engine
put.description:
Sends a replace (AC) request for a running strategy. Requires execution_service or copy_operation_service access and ownership of the ClOrdID.

The body uses the same flat format as creation but is a **partial patch**: only `StrategyCode` is mandatory; send only the fields to change. General parameters that can be edited at the root are `EndTime`, `ExpireDate`, `TimeInForce` and `BasketId` (`Name` and `InitTime` are ignored). Each `StrategyLegs` item must carry its `LegRefID` (`<ClOrdID>:<leg number>`, see the GET snapshot). Fields marked "Not editable after creation" in the creation schemas are rejected by the execution engine. `MaxGain`/`MaxLoss` inside `CustomParameters` are not sent to the engine; they are stored for the FlexTrade view. Rejected outside trading hours (400); invalid signature yields 403.

500.description: Communication problem sending the edit request to the execution engine

post.description:
Enqueues accounts for custody loading. Requires the `UAD` or copy operator (`UCO`) role.

`UAD` requests must inform `accounts` (a non-empty list of account codes). `UCO` requests must inform `productCode` instead, and every account subscribed to that product is enqueued.

byProductCode.summary: Load custody for every account of a product (UCO)

403.description: Role not allowed to load custody, or one of the requested accounts is not available

post.description:
Creates a copy strategy and immediately sends an AB order to every eligible account for the subscribed product. Requires the `UCO` role.

Accounts whose product is configured with push confirmation in `MANUAL` mode are not sent immediately: they are set to `AWAITING_CONFIRM` and a push notification is sent to the end user instead. Those accounts are counted in `summary.awaiting` and are not listed in `targets`.

post.description:
Accepts or rejects a copy strategy target that is awaiting push confirmation. The `nonce` must match the value issued with the push notification / pending-confirmations record.

On `ACCEPT`, an optional `StrategyTemplate` patch can be supplied to edit the canonical template before sending. On `REJECT`, the target is simply marked as rejected.

403.description: Role not allowed to confirm targets, target not owned by this user, or invalid nonce

409.description: Target is not awaiting confirmation (already resolved)

500.description: Failed to send the strategy to the execution engine

post.description:
Applies a partial AC replace patch to multiple copied strategies.

Exactly one of `SelectionId` or `ClOrdIDs` must be provided. `SelectionId` refers to a selection previously created by the selectAll flow. `StrategyTemplate` is a partial patch: omitted fields are preserved.

Only strategies with OrdStatus `0` (NEW), `3` (RUNNING), or `9` (SUSPENDED) are editable. Individual failures do not abort the batch.

price.description: Limit price. Required for ordType 2 and 4; must not be sent on market orders.

stopPrice.description: Stop trigger price, sent at the root of the order (there is no `customParams` object in this endpoint). Required for ordType 3 (STOP) and 4 (STOP LIMIT); internally mapped to the strategy `CustomParameters.StopPrice`. For STOP LIMIT the limit `price` must be >= `stopPrice` on BUY and <= on SELL.

takeProfit.description: Bracket: take-profit price. Creates a LIMIT child on the opposite side, sent when the entry executes. Must be above `price` on BUY and below on SELL. Works as OCO with the stop-loss child.

trailingStopPips.description: Bracket: trailing-stop distance in ticks (minimum price increments). Creates a STOP LIMIT child whose stop price follows the best price after the entry fills. Cannot be combined with `stopLoss`.

timeInForce.description: Order validity, sent as a string (FIX TimeInForce). 0=DAY / DIA (default); 1=GTC / VAC (valid until cancelled); 6=GTD / DES (valid until `expireDate`, which becomes mandatory); 3=IOC; 4=FOK; 7=At the close; A=Good for auction. Numeric values are rejected downstream, always send the string form.

expireDate.description: Expiration date (YYYYMMDD). Rules by `timeInForce`: `6` (DES) requires it and it must be a BVMF business day (weekends/holidays → 400); `1` (VAC) defaults to today + 10 years when omitted; `0` (DIA) is always forced to the current date, any value sent is ignored.

ABMessage-sorder.description: Single Order (sorder) creation message. CustomParameters follow the execution-engine contract (BypassFirewall, InitSuspended, PriceLimit, StopPrice, MaxFloor, UseOrderProxy, TakeProfit, StopLoss, SyntheticBracket, TrailingStopPips, EntranceTimeout, ClosePosition, CancelEntranceOnBracketExecution); the edit contract accepts only PriceLimit, StopPrice, TakeProfit, StopLoss and TrailingStopPips.

PriceLimit.description: Limit price. Required when LegOrdType is 2 (limit).

StopPrice.description: Trigger price for stop orders (LegOrdType 3 or 4).

StopLoss.description: Bracket: stop-loss trigger price. Creates a STOP LIMIT child on the opposite side, sent when the entry executes. Below the entry price on BUY, above on SELL. Not with TrailingStopPips.

TakeProfit.description: Bracket: take-profit price. Creates a LIMIT child on the opposite side (OCO with the stop child), sent when the entry executes. Above the entry price on BUY, below on SELL.

TrailingStopPips.description: Bracket: trailing-stop distance in ticks. Creates a STOP LIMIT child whose stop follows the best price after the entry fills. Not with StopLoss.

MaxFloor.description: Displayed (visible) quantity for an iceberg-style single order. 0 or omitted shows the whole quantity. Not propagated to bracket children. Not editable.

InitSuspended.description: Y to create the order in SUSPENDED state; it is only sent to the market after a resume command. Not editable.

BypassFirewall.description: Internal use (risk firewall bypass). Defaults to N; ignored on edit.

SyntheticBracket.description: How the bracket children are worked by the engine. OFF (default, unless the engine config overrides it): children rest at the exchange (take profit as LIMIT, stop loss as STOP LIMIT). AGGRESSOR: children are held by the engine and, when a trade reaches the level, an aggressive market-with-leftover-as-limit order is sent. NEAR: children are held and sent (take profit as LIMIT, stop loss as STOP) only when the last trade comes within 10 ticks of the level; if price moves more than 15 ticks away the resting order is cancelled and re-armed. GAIN_OFF_LOSS_AGG: take profit rests as LIMIT (OFF) while the stop loss works as AGGRESSOR. With NEAR, if StopLoss and TakeProfit are within 10 ticks of each other the engine falls back to AGGRESSOR. Not editable.

EntranceTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for the entry order to execute after it starts working; when it elapses the remaining entry quantity is cancelled (brackets already created for executed quantity keep working). 0 = disabled. Not editable through the API (absent from the edit XSD).

ClosePosition.description: 0 = none (default). 1 = close position at EndTime: the quantity executed by the entry is closed with a market order at the strategy EndTime (implemented as an additional take-profit child with price "Mercado" scheduled for EndTime, OCO with the other brackets). Not editable through the API.

CancelEntranceOnBracketExecution.description: Y: when a bracket child finishes executing, the remaining (unfilled) quantity of the entry order is cancelled. Default N. Not editable through the API.

UseOrderProxy.description: Y to route the order through the order proxy (required for bracket orders). Not editable after creation.

ABMessage-fxorder.description: Flex Order (fxorder) creation message. Entry order with stop loss / stop gain management.

OrderQuantity.description: Total quantity of the entry order.

CustomOrdType.description: Entry order type. 1=MARKET; 2=START (buy above / sell below trigger); 3=STOP; 4=LIMIT; 5=AUCTION.

UseAuctionOpenPrice.description: For CustomOrdType 5 (AUCTION), Y uses the auction open price as entry price.

StartPriceTrigger.description: Entry trigger/limit price. Required when CustomOrdType is START, LIMIT, or AUCTION with UseAuctionOpenPrice=N.

EntranceExecPrice.description: Limit price of the entry order after the stop triggers. Used when CustomOrdType is STOP.

StopType.description: 1=STOP_GAIN_LOSS (fixed stop gain and loss); 2=STOP_MOVING (trailing); 3=STOP_PARTIAL (up to 3 gain levels).

StopLoss.description: Stop loss distance (points or %, see TriggerEntryType).

StopGain.description: Stop gain distance. Used when StopType is 1.

ReversionType.description: 1=Revert position on EndTime or on cancel; 2=Revert on closing auction or on cancel; 3=Revert only when gain/loss triggers; 4=Do not revert.

UseLevel3.description: Y enables the third partial stop gain level (StopType 3).

StopGainL3.description: Partial stop gain distance, level 3 (StopType 3, UseLevel3=Y).

ABMessage-oco.description: OCO (one-cancels-the-other) creation message. Same flat format as every other strategy.

UseAuctionOrder.description: Y to send the entry as an auction order.

StartTriggerPrice.description: Entry trigger/limit price (START, LIMIT or STOP entries).

EntranceExecPrice.description: Limit price of the entry order after the stop triggers (STOP entries).

ReversionType.description: 1=Revert on EndTime or cancel; 2=Revert on closing auction or cancel; 3=Revert only on gain/loss; 4=Do not revert.

ABMessage-boffer.description: Best Offer (boffer) creation message. Keeps a clip at the best price of the book.

PriceLimit.description: Worst price accepted when following the best offer.

ABMessage-sniper.description: Sniper (sniper) creation message. Aggresses the book whenever the price reaches PriceLimit.

PriceLimit.description: Trigger price. When touched the strategy aggresses the book.

RestingPrice.description: Price difference (from PriceLimit) at which the resting clip is kept.

TriggerValue.description: Target value of the trigger (spread or financial difference) that fires the execution.

Trigger.description: Trigger type. Allowed values depend on the strategy (see each strategy schema).

ToMarketTriggerValue.description: Trigger value at which the strategy goes to market (aggresses) regardless of ExecStrategy.

BandPriceRef.description: Y restricts execution to a price band of a reference symbol.

BandPriceSymbol.description: Reference symbol for the price band.

BandPriceHigh.description: Upper limit of the price band.

BandPriceLow.description: Lower limit of the price band.

IgnoreOffersLT.description: Ignore book offers with quantity lower than this value.

BookDepth.description: Number of book levels considered when computing the trigger.

CompensateExec.description: How execution imbalance between legs is compensated. 0=None; 1=On next clip; 2=Gradually.

ExecutionLimit.description: Type of execution limit applied to the strategy. 7=default.

SimulateSniperOnResting.description: Y simulates sniper behaviour on the resting leg.

ABMessage-spread.description: Spread creation message. Use StrategyCode `spread` for 2 legs, `spread3p`..`spread6p` for 3 to 6 legs; the number of StrategyLegs must match the code.

ABMessage-lgshort.description: Long & Short (lgshort) creation message. Pair trading triggered by spread, ratio or statistical bands.

Trigger.description: 1=Spread; 2=Ratio buy/sell; 3=Ratio sell/buy; 4=Spread difference buy/sell; 5=Spread difference sell/buy; 11=Financial difference; 18/19=Statistical (standard deviation) triggers.

CandleTimeFrame.description: Candle time frame used by statistical triggers.

CandleUpdate.description: Candle price used in the computation. O=Open; M=Mid; A=Average; L=Last.

NumCandles.description: Number of candles in the statistical window.

TriggerValueDesvPad.description: Number of standard deviations used by statistical triggers.

EntrancePrice.description: Price of the first grid entry.

IncrementPriceStopGain.description: Price distance from each entry at which the stop gain order is placed.

StopLossFinance.description: Global financial stop loss of the grid.

NumberOfMinPriceIncrementsToStart.description: Number of minimum price increments the market must move before the grid starts.

UseStartWhenCross.description: Y starts the grid only when the price crosses StartWhenCross.

StartWhenCross.description: Price that must be crossed to start the grid.

StopGainGlobalFinance.description: Global financial stop gain of the grid.

SendStopLossOnEnd.description: Y closes open positions before the strategy finishes.

UsePreservation.description: Y enables profit preservation (trailing of the global gain).

PreservationStep.description: Step used to raise the preservation level.

MaximumZeroTimeWindow.description: Maximum time window (seconds) for flattening positions.

ZerarStopLoss.description: Y flattens the position when the stop loss triggers.

UseRetroaliment.description: Y enables feedback (retroalimentation) that re-opens entries after gains.

RetroalimentTimeWindow.description: Time window (seconds) of the feedback evaluation.

RetroalimentParam1.description: Parameter of the selected feedback mode.

ABMessage-arbintf.description: Index future vs. mini index arbitrage (arbintf) creation message. Two legs (full and fractional contracts).

Variation.description: Target spread variation between the two contracts.

MaxDifSpreadInteiro.description: Maximum spread difference accepted on the full contract leg.

PassiveQtyLimitPerc.description: Passive quantity limit as a fraction (0..1) of the book quantity.

StopFinanceActive.description: Financial stop of the active side.

StopFinancePassive.description: Financial stop of the passive side.

EndTimeHedgeLoss.description: Maximum hedge loss accepted at EndTime.

StopLossFracPerc.description: Stop loss (%) of the fractional leg.

StopGainFracPerc.description: Stop gain (%) of the fractional leg.

OpenNetQuantity.description: Initial net open quantity. Not editable after creation.

QuantityToIgnoreInteiro.description: Book quantity to ignore on the full contract.

QuantityToIgnoreFrac.description: Book quantity to ignore on the fractional contract.

NumberOfOrdersToIgnoreFrac.description: Number of orders to ignore on the fractional contract.

ABMessage-twap.description: TWAP (twap) creation message. Slices the quantity evenly between InitTime and EndTime.

AgressionLevel.description: 0=Counterparty (aggress the best counter offer); 2=Participate (rest in the book).

UsingFinancialVolume.description: Y expresses the target in financial volume (MaxFinancialVolume) instead of quantity.

MaxFinancialVolume.description: Financial volume to execute. Required when UsingFinancialVolume=Y.

LimitByVolume.description: Y limits participation to TargetPercent of the market volume.

TargetPercent.description: Maximum participation (%) of the market volume (LimitByVolume=Y).

ConsiderCrossOrders.description: Y includes cross trades in the market volume.

PriceLimit.description: Limit price. Required when LegOrdType is 2.

TargetPercent.description: Target participation (%) of the market volume.

ParticipateOwnVolume.description: Y counts the strategy's own executions in the market volume. Not editable after creation.

ConsiderCrossOrders.description: Y includes intentional cross trades in the volume. Not editable after creation.

ConsiderCrossOrdersNotIntentional.description: Y includes non-intentional cross trades in the volume. Not editable after creation.

ConsiderPriceLimitInVolume.description: Y only counts volume traded within PriceLimit. Not editable after creation.

PriceLimit.description: Limit price. Required when LegOrdType is 2.

LegMaxClipSize.description: Maximum clip size, in multiples of 100.

LegFirstTimeOut.description: First timeout (ms) before re-pricing a resting clip.

LegSecondTimeOut.description: Second timeout (ms) before aggressing a resting clip.

ABMessage-iceberg.description: Iceberg (iceberg) creation message. Shows only LegMaxClipSize of the total quantity at a time.

FixedOpenQuantity.description: Y keeps the displayed quantity fixed at LegMaxClipSize; N randomises it.

TriggerValue.description: Target volatility difference (%) that fires the execution.

InterestRate.description: Risk-free interest rate (%) used in the volatility model.

ABMessage-skew.description: Volatility skew (skew) creation message. Three legs (two options and the underlying).

DaysToExpiration1.description: Days to expiration of option leg 1.

DaysToExpiration2.description: Days to expiration of option leg 2.

ABMessage-cvvol.description: Buy/sell volatility (cvvol) creation message. Two legs (option and underlying).

DeltaFixedValue.description: Fixed delta of the option leg (DeltaType=1).

DaysToExpiration.description: Days to expiration of the option.

CustomMetrics.description: Free string with customMetrics information. Used for  TWAP and VWAP strategies to inform curve data. Will be empty when no information is passed.

accountsQueued.description: Accounts without a custody index that were queued for loading.

productCode.description: Required for the copy operator (UCO) role. Loads custody for every account subscribed to this product.

accounts.description: Required for the default (UAD) role. Account codes to (re)load custody for.

SelectionId.description: UUID of a persisted selection. Mutually exclusive with ClOrdIDs.

ClOrdIDs.description: Direct list of strategy ClOrdIDs. Mutually exclusive with SelectionId.

SelectionId.description: UUID of a persisted selection. Mutually exclusive with ClOrdIDs.

ClOrdIDs.description: Direct list of strategy ClOrdIDs. Mutually exclusive with SelectionId.

Name.description: Display name of the copy strategy.

Signature.description: Base64-encoded electronic signature of the UCO operator.

StrategyTemplate.description: Strategy template used as the base AB order for every target account.

Accounts.description: Optional subset of account codes to target. When omitted, all eligible accounts for the product are used.

fileKey.description: Optional reference to an attached file (e.g. analysis backing the recommendation).

targets.description: One entry per account that was sent immediately. Accounts awaiting push confirmation are not listed here.

username.description: Only allowed for UAD role. Standard users can only manage their own configuration.

pushConfirmationMode.description: Only applicable when the product supports push notification.

nonce.description: Nonce received in the push notification / pending-confirmations record.

StrategyTemplate.description: Optional client edits applied on top of the canonical template. Only used when action is ACCEPT.

desc.example: Replace request sent to exec engine. Please check the snapshot url for status updates.

ExpireDate.description: New expiration date (YYYYMMDD, today or later).

Signature.description: Electronic signature of the user, when required by the sponsor.

StrategyEditBase.description: Root-level fields accepted on a strategy edit (partial patch).

body_2.description: Strategy-specific editable CustomParameters / StrategyLegs, selected by StrategyCode.

NoContentBody.description: Request successfully processed with an empty JSON response

ExecutionResponse.description: Single execution object. detailed=true can include all additional valid fields stored in the execution hash.

detailed.summary: Detailed execution with stored order metadata

NotFound.description: The specified resource was not found

Stop-orders.summary: Stop limit (ordType 4) valid until date (timeInForce 6 / DES)

Trailing-orders.summary: Market order with trailing stop (20 ticks)

GTC-orders.summary: Limit order valid until cancelled (timeInForce 1 / VAC)

Bracket-orders.summary: Limit order with stop loss and take profit

sorder-bracket.summary: SingleOrder with bracket (stop loss + take profit)
